description: Build a clean .glb (UVs, tangents, one node per part, same bytes every time) from a ready-made `kind` (with `params`), a model `spec` or a `spec_file`, write it to `out` (replaced if it exists) and lint it. If the spec or kind has an "archetype", the result is also checked against what that thing should be. Pass `collision`: most models need one. `contract_out` also writes a model.contract.json that godot_model_lint can hold later versions to. Returns the size, triangle and node count, then the lint report; an error result when the lint finds errors, though the file is still written. Call godot_model_identify first and godot_model_spec for the format; to check a .glb not built here, use godot_model_lint.

collision.description: collision for Godot: convex (a hull per mesh on import, for props and vehicles), trimesh (exact triangles on import, for buildings), or heightmap (terrain tiles: writes <name>.heightmap.tres and <name>.tscn with a StaticBody3D, faster than trimesh)

contract_out.description: also write a model.contract.json here (inside the project)

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

kind.description: a ready-made kind: house, terrain, sea, airliner, apartment, barn, barrel, bicycle, boat, bridge, bus, bush, campfire, car, castle, chair, church, conifer, crash-barrier, crate, delineator, dragon, drone, fence, fighter, flower, grandstand, grass, guard-rail, helicopter, horse, humanoid, jet-engine, light-aircraft, motorcycle, palm, piston-engine, power-pylon, race-kerb, railway-track, road, rocket, rowing-boat, sailboat, satellite, ship, shipping-container, spaceship, street-lamp, table, tank, tower, tractor, traffic-sign, train, tree, truck, wind-turbine, windmill

out.description: where to write the .glb, inside the project, e.g. models/car.glb

spec.description: a full model spec as a JSON object

spec_file.description: or a path to a spec JSON file inside the project

textures.description: false writes plain colours instead of the texture maps of brick, wood, leaves and the like (smaller files, or for materials of your own); default true

name: godot_model_build
title: Build a 3D model from code
